heading: The Production Crew & Behind the Scenes
description: Operating as an agile production collective across Cambridge, London, and the UK. Combining multi-camera live broadcast control, cinema-grade camera rigs, pristine field audio, and dedicated post-production mastering.

slides.name: FilmEditRun Production Collective
slides.bio: Multi-camera live stages, commercial cinematography, and rapid film operations across the UK.

slides.name: Wireless Camera Rig On Location
slides.bio: Rigged for rapid mobility during high-tempo conference coverage. Anamorphic glass, wireless video transmitter, and 12-hour continuous battery power.

slides.name: Multi-Cam Live Switch Deck
slides.bio: Director's multi-view monitoring 6 live SDI feeds with redundant hardware recording and instant replay triggers.

slides.name: Colour Timing & Mastering Suite
slides.bio: Calibrated reference monitoring in our Cambridge suite, dialling in natural skin tones and rich cinematic contrast curves.

slides.name: Field Audio & Spatial Isolation
slides.bio: Dual boom and RF wireless microphones dialed in to reject venue echo and capture crystal-clear speaker nuance.
